Use case: precise-object-edit / background extension. Input image is a STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCE for GameNight Host portal artwork. Create a NEW NATIVE ULTRA-WIDE PANORAMIC HERO ASSET, exactly 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3072x1024 pixels (THREE TIMES as wide as high). The final output canvas itself must be a wide panoramic rectangle, not a 3:2 image containing a strip. No padding, no bars, full-bleed artwork.
Preserve the reference's premium luminous fantasy world: lilac stone arch with an intricate swirling magenta/cyan/violet galaxy, floral vines, broad stone steps, lavender mountain valley, delicate aurora in deep blue-violet sky, mist and enchanting light.
CRITICAL RECOMPOSITION: pull the camera far back. Position the ENTIRE portal arch on the RIGHT, between 65% and 88% of canvas width. Portal including its full arch and base occupies only 65% of total IMAGE HEIGHT; top of arch at 16% of image height, bottom of arch around 70%; stone steps extend to 88% height. Leave clear sky above the arch, ground below all steps and plenty of air to its right. No portion of arch, vines or steps may touch or cross the edges. It must look like a beautiful distant doorway within a grand landscape, not a giant close-up vortex.
The LEFT 48% is quiet dark lavender sky and low distant mountains, intentionally low-contrast for an HTML heading and button overlay, but NO actual text in the image. The middle is a natural broad valley connecting both sides, no seam. Finely detailed cinematic illustration, joyful luminous pink, lavender and cyan, lush flowers, majestic delicate landscapes, polished crisp native detail. Keep the full original palette. Lower edge naturally fades into violet mist. No user interface, no letters, no logo, no title, no badges, no inset illustration, no browser, no border. Do not stretch objects. Do not crop a taller portal image; recompose the whole scene for this wide frame.
